categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a reachability-checking framework in src/test/fuzz/util/ and instruments 11 fuzz targets across p2p, mempool, and validation.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent regressions in corpus coverage by failing fuzz CI if high-value execution paths stop being reached. As noted in commit bcf97a3cc4, this 'allows corpus CI to detect lost path coverage without a separate build configuration' across critical targets like mempool package evaluation and p2p handshakes.
